what_it_is.prose: DRDO's 2024 news-clipping record reports about 66 IAF MiG-29 aircraft in service and describes extensive modernization that created the MiG-29UPG configuration. The upgrade included airframe work, new avionics, radar, missiles, weapon-control systems and electronic warfare. The same record reports that the IAF was considering a further life-extension programme. The aircraft remains Soviet/Russian-origin; the dossier records Indian upgrade and sustainment participation without asserting unsupported localization percentages.
